sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def tstate():
    seg=current_frame.segmentation
    st={}
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['pixels']==3 and n['boundary'][0][0]>=42:
            c=n['boundary'][0][1]
            part='bar' if n['boundary'][0][0]==42 else 'stem'
            st[(c,part)]=n['color']
    # group by T index (col of bar: 20,25,30,35,40; stem col+1)
    bars={20:0,25:1,30:2,35:3,40:4}; stems={21:0,26:1,31:2,36:3,41:4}
    out=['?']*5
    for (c,part),col in st.items():
        i = bars.get(c) if part=='bar' else stems.get(c)
        if i is not None: out[i]=col
    return ''.join(out)
print("start:", tstate())
res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':42,'col':41},{'action':'MOUSE','row':45,'col':41}])
print("T5=B:", tstate(), res.get('level_completed'), res.get('done'))
if not (res.get('level_completed') or res.get('done')):
    res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':42,'col':21},{'action':'MOUSE','row':45,'col':21}])
    print("T1=B:", tstate(), res.get('level_completed'), res.get('done'))
if not (res.get('level_completed') or res.get('done')):
    res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':42,'col':26},{'action':'MOUSE','row':45,'col':26},
                 {'action':'MOUSE','row':42,'col':31},{'action':'MOUSE','row':45,'col':31},
                 {'action':'MOUSE','row':42,'col':36},{'action':'MOUSE','row':45,'col':36}])
    print("all B:", tstate(), res.get('level_completed'), res.get('done'), res.get('game_over'))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
